# Streams

> Streams helps people find their next film or series. It builds rows from taste, mood, season and themes, has profiles (including a Kids profile), trailers, a My List and viewing progress that follow the account, and a Help Center. Free, open source, in 16 languages. Everything but the landing page, sign in and up, the Help Center and the policies needs a free account.

## For people

- [Streams](https://streams.watch/): the landing page, what Streams is and how to start
- [Help Center](https://streams.watch/help): how profiles, My List, ratings, languages, devices, privacy and the account work
- [Contact](https://streams.watch/help/contact): how to reach the team
- [Sign up](https://streams.watch/signup): make a free account

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://streams.watch/privacy)
- [Cookies](https://streams.watch/cookies)
- [Terms](https://streams.watch/terms)
- [Disclaimer](https://streams.watch/disclaimer)
- [DMCA](https://streams.watch/dmca)
- [Credits](https://streams.watch/credits)

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://streams.watch/sitemap.xml)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Coderia397/streams-frontend-rs): the website, written in Rust (Leptos, compiled to WebAssembly)
- [Engine](https://github.com/Coderia397/streams-engine): the recommendation engine, written in Rust
